core_invariant: Many-to-many Change, Build, TestRun, Artifact, and Deployment relations are representable through canonical edges and explicit manifest membership.
strict_reference_profile: A selected Build, TestRun, or Artifact is unique to one manifest row.
alternative_profile_or_boundary: Shared-build and shared-test profiles must record contribution membership and preserve digest and service boundaries.

core_invariant: Each Deployment is a separate event linked to one ReleaseDecision and environment.
strict_reference_profile: Every linked Deployment must finish its observation window before closed_as_of.
alternative_profile_or_boundary: Canary and blue-green profiles retain separate Deployment nodes and may record phased traffic weights outside the current schema.

core_invariant: Rollback is a new controlled event and cannot rewrite prior evidence.
strict_reference_profile: Current reference implementation records the successor release/snapshot but has no component-level rollback object.
alternative_profile_or_boundary: A component profile must add component identity and rollback scope before claiming partial rollback support.

core_invariant: A hotfix is a new Change and release episode with explicit precedence.
strict_reference_profile: No silent mutation of an approved ReleaseDecision.
alternative_profile_or_boundary: Emergency profiles may shorten gates only through predeclared policy and authority; nonwaivable gates remain blocking.

core_invariant: One policy version is bound to a release episode.
strict_reference_profile: All decision gates, manifest rows, and exceptions use that bound version.
alternative_profile_or_boundary: The V18 reference profile supports policy change only through a new release episode with full reevaluation; in-episode migration is future work and is not claimed.

core_invariant: An exception is a declared false gate decision plus scoped approval, never evidence that the predicate passed.
strict_reference_profile: Only waiver_allowed=yes gates may use exception; authority and interval checks apply at decision time.
alternative_profile_or_boundary: Revocation after an immutable snapshot is not retroactive rewriting; it requires a direct successor snapshot and governance action.

strict_reference_profile: gate_scope=* is allowed only when all gates in the policy version have one owner and the delegator is that owner.
alternative_profile_or_boundary: Multi-owner policy versions require gate-specific rows.
